spanish: Y levantarás el mishkán conforme a su juicio que fuiste mostrado en el monte.

findings.issue: Common noun הַמִּשְׁכָּן (H4908) is left as the untranslated lemma mishkán; a common noun must be Spanish.

notes: The other tokens match: hiphil 2ms, כְּ + suffix, relative, hophal 2ms, and בָּהָר.
